name: Shell Command
description: The aicode command in your terminal, as VS Code has code: `aicode .` opens the folder, `aicode -g file:12` a line, `aicode -d a b` a diff, `aicode -w` waits for the file to close (git's editor). Installed in the PATH when AICode starts.
author: AICode

autoInstall.description: Install (and keep up to date) the aicode command when AICode starts, in a folder of the PATH that needs no password. When only /usr/local/bin is left (macOS), AICode asks once.
